blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Cross the Tancredo Neves Bridge and join a group tour of the Argentine side of the falls with an English-speaking guide. Paths and walkways lead to close-up views of the cascades and the Devil’s Throat.

After the tour, transfer to the airport for the included flight to Buenos Aires. On arrival, a driver will take you to your hotel.

blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Join a 3-hour group sightseeing tour of Buenos Aires with an English-speaking guide. The tour introduces you to the capital’s historic quarters and modern districts.

In the evening, a tango show with dinner is included: traditional dishes, Argentine wines and a dance performance in a restaurant.
